name: Puma Steel
old_description: With decades of experience throughout the Western U.S., Puma Steel provides exceptional fabrication, project management, BIM modeling, engineering services, in-house detailing, design build, and design assist services for structural steel in Colorado, Wyoming, and across the West. At Puma, you will find a dependable partner for your projects, and consistently outstanding service from our engineers, project managers, and quality specialists. Through use of the most advanced equipment and new technologies, we have become the premier provider of structural steel for Colorado, Wyoming, and anywhere our customers need a valued team member.
about:
Based in Cheyenne, Wyoming, Puma Steel has operated for decades across the Western United States as a structural steel fabricator and supplier. The company serves Colorado, Wyoming, and surrounding states from its Cheyenne yards, where it maintains thousands of tons of steel inventory.

Puma Steel provides a full range of steel services including structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, design-build, design-assist, steel supply, pre-processing, project management, in-house BIM modeling, engineering, detailing, value engineering, erection, and LEED documentation. The firm dedicates in-house engineers, project managers, and quality specialists to each project, and its fabrication capacity is supported by large yard stock.

The company works primarily with general contractors on commercial, healthcare, education, and government projects. Notable examples include the 1144 Fifteenth office tower in Denver (GC Hensel Phelps), the Utah Data Center at Camp Williams, the Marian H. Rochelle Gateway Center at the University of Wyoming (GC Haselden Construction), and medical centers such as Platte Valley Medical Center and Lutheran Medical Center.

Puma Steel emphasizes communication, professionalism, and safety as differentiators. It holds AISC certification as a fabricator since 1997, maintains AWS-certified welding inspectors, and operates an award-winning safety program. The firm also offers non-destructive testing (NDT Level I and II) including liquid penetrant, magnetic particle, and ultrasonic inspection, along with sophisticated paint coating endorsements (P1, P2, P3).

name: PwrQ
old_description: Same products. Same solutions. Now backed by the speed of Forgent.
about:
PwrQ is based in Hanover, Maryland, and traces its roots to 1926. The company is now part of Forgent, a platform that brings together over a century of experience in power infrastructure. No founder names are disclosed, and ownership details beyond the Forgent affiliation are not specified.

PwrQ designs and manufactures low-voltage power distribution equipment, including its S1 switchboard line, remote power panels (RPP), panelboards (120/208 V to 600 V), and power distribution units (PDU) with integrated monitoring. The company operates vertically integrated facilities that handle raw copper busbar fabrication, CNC turret punching, laser cutting, robotic welding, and final assembly and test. Dedicated production lanes for each product family enable high-volume, high-precision output. A planned 220,000-square-foot expansion near the current headquarters will add capacity.

The company serves hyperscale data centers, manufacturing plants, utility and grid operators, hospitals, and other mission-critical facilities. Its engineering teams support projects from utility service entrance to rack-level load, while field service crews provide preventive maintenance, commissioning, retrofits, and generator solutions (3 kW to 10 MW) across the U.S.

PwrQ emphasizes that vertical integration gives it control over quality, lead times, and capacity. Dedicated lanes and AI-driven machinery aim to reduce variability and accelerate throughput. The firm also highlights its end-to-end engineering capability—spanning single-line design, selective coordination, arc-flash studies, and SCADA/BMS integration—as a differentiator for complex, fast-paced projects.

name: Pyramid Semiconductor
old_description: Pyramid Semiconductor is a manufacturer of semiconductor Integrated Circuits including MIL-STD-1750A Processors, SRAMs, EEPROMs and FCT/FCT-T Logic.
about:
Pyramid Semiconductor is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. The company was formed in January 2003 when it acquired the product lines of Performance Semiconductor. In March 2021, HEICO Corporation's Electronic Technologies Group acquired Pyramid Semiconductor, and the business now operates as part of HEICO/3D PLUS USA in Silicon Valley.

Pyramid Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor manufacturer producing integrated circuits including MIL-STD-1750A processors, SRAMs, EEPROMs, FCT/FCT-T logic, and multi-chip modules. Wafers are fabricated at outside foundries (TSMC in Taiwan and LA Semiconductor in the USA), while the company's 10,000-square-foot Sunnyvale facility handles wafer testing, ceramic clean-room assembly, burn-in, environmental testing, electrical testing, marking, and quality assurance. The company supports over 100 Standard Military Drawings (SMDs) and offers custom logic functions and packaging with short lead times.

The company serves military, aerospace, industrial, and commercial markets. Its MIL-STD-1750A processors have been used by military customers for over two decades, and its QML-certified manufacturing line supports more than 100 SMDs for defense and aerospace programs. Industrial and commercial customers use its SRAMs, EEPROMs, and logic devices in embedded systems requiring high reliability and long-term supply.

Pyramid Semiconductor positions itself as a sole-source supplier committed to long-term availability of legacy MIL-STD-1750A products. It emphasizes a secure, independent supply chain with established foundry relationships and in-house assembly and test capabilities to ensure continued availability and short lead times for custom solutions.

name: Q Cells USA
old_description: Q Cells is a solar panel manufacturer and energy solutions provider. Products include bifacial solar modules, energy storage systems and power electronics, suitable for utility and commercial solar installations.
about:
Q Cells USA, headquartered in Placentia, California, was founded in 1999. The company operates as a solar panel manufacturer and energy solutions provider with a stated commitment to American manufacturing, including a PV solar cell production facility in Cartersville, Georgia.

The company manufactures bifacial solar modules, energy storage systems, and power electronics such as battery management systems and inverters. With a workforce of 100 to 499 employees, Q Cells delivers complete energy solutions that integrate hardware and software for residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations.

Q Cells serves the residential, commercial, industrial, and utility sectors. Its customer base includes homeowners, businesses, government agencies, and utilities nationwide. Notable engagements include a strategic alliance with Microsoft to explore energy capacity for AI infrastructure, and the company cites a No.1 market-share position in U.S. solar module leaderboards.

Q Cells emphasizes its long-haul U.S. commitment, highlighting its heritage in quality and innovation. The company states it was the first to achieve UL and IEC certification by TÜV Rheinland on next-generation solar technology, positioning its American-made products as a differentiator in the clean energy transition.

name: Qualcomm Technologies
old_description: Qualcomm is a semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company based in California. Designs and supplies chips and modems for mobile phones and wireless devices, as well as automotive and IoT applications.
about:
Qualcomm Technologies was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, California. The company operates as a subsidiary of Qualcomm Incorporated, focusing on engineering, research and development, and its semiconductor business known as QCT.

The company designs and supplies chips and modems for mobile phones, wireless devices, automotive systems, and IoT applications. Its product portfolio includes mobile system-on-chips (SoCs), modems, and RF transceivers, marketed under brands such as Snapdragon, Dragonwing, and Dragonfly. Qualcomm also provides AI hardware acceleration, connectivity solutions spanning 5G, 6G, and Wi-Fi, and developer platforms like the Qualcomm AI Hub and Windows on Snapdragon. The organization employs more than 1,000 people.

Qualcomm serves industries including mobile devices, automotive, IoT, data center, PC and compute, extended reality (XR), wearables, audio, and gaming. Its customers are primarily device manufacturers, OEMs, and developers building products that require integrated compute, connectivity, and on-device AI.

The company states its mission is to engineer human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. It emphasizes leading-edge AI, high-performance low-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity as the foundation of its differentiation, and has positioned itself as a developer-first AI solutions company through acquisitions and multi-generational collaborations such as its work with Amazon on AI data center infrastructure.

name: Quality Craft Wood Works Inc
old_description: Your kitchen is the heart of the home. It’s where meals are prepared, memories are made, and friends and family gather. That’s why Quality Craft Woodworks specializes in crafting kitchen cabinets Utah homeowners can trust for durability, elegance, and function. Every detail matters in a kitchen — from soft close hinges to the type of wood, the layout of the drawers, and the way your appliances integrate with the design. Our cabinet makers use high-quality materials to ensure your cabinets not only look stunning but also stand the test of time.
about:
Quality Craft Wood Works Inc was established in 1980 in Rocky Ridge, Utah. The company began with a focus on service and has built its business primarily through customer referrals.

The company manufactures custom cabinetry including kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, built-in entertainment centers, and home office shelving. Using latest machine technology, they produce precision-designed wood products with a range of finishes—over 30 color and wood options—and provide in-house design consultation, manufacturing, and installation services. A limited one-year warranty covers all cabinets.

Quality Craft serves residential customers across Northern Utah, including Salt Lake City, working directly with homeowners, builders, and interior designers. The firm’s portfolio includes hundreds of completed projects for kitchen remodels, new home construction, and bathroom upgrades.

The company differentiates itself by eliminating non-essential elements to keep cabinets affordable while including features essential for durability, offering personal attention rather than mass-produced designs, and maintaining a referral-based reputation for quality and price.

name: Quality Foods Distributing LLC
old_description: Quality Foods Distributing serve as the premier distributor of natural, organic, sustainable and locally-produced products across Montana and the Northern Rockies region. We offer a great selection of the highest quality products, including exceptional regionally made goods that invest in our local talents & economy. We provide consistent, reliable service and support to a wide variety of businesses and institutions.
about:
Quality Foods Distributing is based in Bozeman, Montana. It was founded by Randy and Nancy Lindberg. Randy’s family had acquired a natural products distributor called Nature’s Best in the late 1960s, and he grew that business into the largest privately owned wholesaler‑distributor in the natural products industry. After leaving that company in 2005 and serving as Western Region President for United Natural Foods, Inc., the Lindbergs moved to Bozeman and launched Quality Foods Distributing to provide reliable logistics and distribution for natural, organic, and local foods across Montana and the Northern Rockies.

The company operates as a wholesale distributor, sourcing natural, organic, specialty, and regionally produced foods from local farmers, ranchers, and brands. It manages warehousing, order fulfillment, and delivery logistics for a range of customers, offering on‑time delivery, sales support, and supplier partnership development. The product portfolio includes hundreds of items from producers such as Ghost Town, Kuju, Mission Mountain Eggs, and many other regional brands.

Quality Foods Distributing serves grocery stores, restaurants and coffee shops, universities and hospitals, hotels, lodges, and national parks throughout Montana and the Northern Rockies. Its customer base includes both independent retailers and institutional foodservice operations.

The Lindbergs started the business to fill a gap in reliable distribution for local producers who struggled to reach retail shelves and commercial kitchens. They emphasize consistent, friendly service, expert logistics, and a commitment to investing in the local economy by connecting regional products with regional buyers.

name: Quality Plastics Inc.
old_description: Quality Plastics & Machine, Incorporated has made custom plastic products for a variety of industries since its inception in 1976. Our products have filled many functions in laboratories, medical equipment, displays, electronics, motor vehicles, entertainment, agriculture, watercraft, aircraft, and even outer space.
about:
Quality Plastics & Machine, Incorporated was founded in 1976 in Sparks, Nevada. The company began as a custom plastics fabricator and has since expanded into a multi-process manufacturing operation.

The shop’s core process is vacuum forming, where rigid thermoplastic sheets are heated and drawn over tooling, complemented by drape forming for optically clear curved parts. In-house capabilities include CNC machining of both plastic and metal parts on machining centers and a dual-spindle lathe with live tooling, five-axis and three-axis CNC routing, laser cutting, and 3D printing for prototypes and fixtures. A fabrication department handles trimming, hardware installation, riveting, threaded fasteners, and inserts, while a turnkey production group manages full builds from part production through electro-mechanical assembly. The company also designs and builds custom automated machines to accelerate production.

Quality Plastics serves laboratories, medical equipment manufacturers, display and electronics firms, motor vehicle and entertainment industries, agriculture, watercraft, and aerospace programs; its parts have flown on multiple space shuttle missions.

The company states its competitive advantage lies in assisting customers with product design, creating tooling, and delivering quality products on time, backed by process controls that minimize warp and improve dimensional stability after forming or machining.

about:
Quality Sheet Metal & Welding operates from Piscataway, New Jersey, where it was founded in 1997. The company has served small and large clients for over 25 years, completing thousands of projects across commercial, industrial, and pharmaceutical sectors.

The shop provides a broad range of fabrication services, including custom stainless steel and carbon steel fabrication, industrial ductwork, HVAC system design and installation, high-definition plasma cutting up to 3/4-inch plate, dust collection systems, and 3D printing in materials such as ABS, polycarbonate, and carbon-fiber-reinforced ABS with a build volume of 14 by 10 by 14 inches and ±0.002-inch accuracy. Additional capabilities cover fume and compressor exhaust systems, DuctSox installation, polished stainless steel finishing (including 316L for pharmaceutical and food-grade work), structural steel platforms and mezzanines, OSHA machine guards, on-site welding, and scheduled shut-down or emergency repair work.

Customers span commercial construction, industrial manufacturing, pharmaceutical and cosmetic production, recycling facilities, woodworking shops, and additive manufacturing users. The company has fabricated ductwork for carpentry cabinet shops, dust collectors for pharmaceutical plants, and custom stainless components for food-grade environments.

Quality Sheet Metal emphasizes hands-on management, creative custom solutions, and a safety-first approach backed by OSHA certifications and a master HVAC license (19HC00288200). It also offers 24/7 communication for time-critical projects.
